name: hapi-evolved

scripts.build:site: bun run --cwd website build && bun run --cwd docs docs:build && cp -r docs/.vitepress/dist website/dist/public/docs
scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:web && (cd hub && bun run generate:embedded-web-assets) && bun run build:hub
scripts.build:single-exe: bun run download:tunwg && bun run build:web && (cd hub && bun run generate:embedded-web-assets) && (cd cli && bun run build:exe:allinone)
scripts.build:single-exe:all: bun run download:tunwg && bun run build:web && (cd hub && bun run generate:embedded-web-assets) && (cd cli && bun run build:exe:allinone:all)
scripts.typecheck: bun run --parallel typecheck:cli typecheck:web typecheck:hub typecheck:relay typecheck:proxy typecheck:runner-auth typecheck:runner-control
scripts.test: bun run test:cli && bun run test:hub && bun run test:web && bun run test:shared && bun run test:relay && bun run test:proxy && bun run test:deployment && bun run test:runner-auth && bun run test:runner-control
scripts.test:mermaid-lightbox:live: timeout 900 env HAPI_LIVE=1 playwright test -c web/playwright.live.config.ts

description: A fast-moving, self-hosted fork of HAPI. Run Claude and Codex from your browser with persistent memory, Codegraph, specialist agents and GitHub plugins.
